articles.title: HealthCLBench:Evaluating Context Learning in Health Conversations through Controlled Case Clusters
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.22362v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Complex health conversations require answers grounded in individual information and currently valid evidence. We evaluate health context learning: acquiring, integrating, and applying relevant context during inference with fixed model parameters to answer health questions and respond appropriately to changes in facts, evidence, or task goals. To our knowledge, Chinese-language medical benchmarks have yet to systematically combine explicit contextual difficulties, controlled case variations, and member-specific medical criteria for open-ended answers. We introduce HealthCLBench, comprising 328 controlled clusters, 1,103 cases, and 4,931 rubric criteria across medical consultation and everyday health management. articles.title: Co-Pilot for Health: Personalized Algorithmic AI Nudging to Improve Health Outcomes
articles.summary: arXiv:2401.10816v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The ability to shape health behaviors of large populations automatically, across wearable types and disease conditions at scale has tremendous potential to improve global health outcomes. We designed and implemented an AI driven platform for digital algorithmic nudging, enabled by a Graph-Neural Network (GNN) based Recommendation System, and granular health behavior data from wearable fitness devices.
